title: Public repository and product-contract boundary
outcomes: Users can query a local JSONL Vault quickly through a small read-only CLI and Raycast adapter.
Public repository artifacts remain reproducible and contain no private vault data.

out: Private vault fixtures or query logs
Cloud answer synthesis in the initial release

constraints: The CLI opens the derived SQLite projection read-only and never writes canonical vault state.
The first release performs deterministic retrieval only and invokes no cloud model.
Public fixtures are synthetic and private runtime paths are configured outside Git.
A stale or structurally incompatible index fails closed.

quality_attributes.scenario: Repository artifacts are prepared for public release.
quality_attributes.measure: Tracked secrets, personal records, private queries, or absolute vault paths

quality_attributes.scenario: A maintainer changes the versioned product or design contract.
quality_attributes.measure: Invalid committed docs/vision.json contracts accepted by the local gate

quality_attributes.scenario: A developer starts from a fresh clone and invokes the repo-local workflow.
quality_attributes.measure: Pinned workflow validation failures after documented bootstrap

risks: OR-style full-text matching can surface a strong hit for only part of a multi-term question.
A synchronized or copied index can become stale relative to canonical JSONL state.
Raycast output and shell diagnostics can accidentally expose private evidence.
